# CurseForge game-version ids the release workflow sends with every upload.
#
# CurseForge identifies Minecraft versions, loaders and environments by numeric
# id. The ids are pinned here and never looked up by name, because a name can be
# ambiguous: "26.2" also matches a stale legacy entry, and an upload tagged with
# it is rejected with errorCode 1009. Before anything is uploaded, the workflow
# asks CurseForge for the name behind each pinned id and stops on any mismatch,
# so a renumbered entry fails loudly instead of tagging a file wrongly.
#
# One `minecraft.<line>` row per Minecraft line of the mod (gradle/mc/<line>.properties),
# and the row's name must be that line. The release is refused, before anything is
# published, when a line has no row or a row has no line. Moving to a new Minecraft
# version means looking up its id and adding a row.
#
# Java versions are deliberately absent: an upload that names one is rejected
# (errorCode 1009).
#
# Ids of the two Minecraft lines: 16498 is 26.2, the id every earlier release of the
# sibling mods used. 17045 is 26.3, confirmed by real uploads of the sibling mods
# (their 26.3 files went up with it). The check against CurseForge's own list still
# runs before the first upload of every release.
#
# key              id      name
minecraft.26.2     16498   26.2
minecraft.26.3     17045   26.3
fabric             7499    Fabric
neoforge           10150   NeoForge
client             9638    Client
server             9639    Server
